description: This file defines a PHP class 'ReturnAction' which serves as a controller in an OpenCart admin module related to managing return actions. It includes methods for listing, adding, editing, saving, and deleting return actions, along with their associated view rendering and data handling logic.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Controller class for managing return actions in the localisation section of OpenCart admin. Handles CRUD operations and view rendering for return actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point, loads language, sets page title, builds breadcrumbs, and renders the main list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the routing to display the list of return actions, utilizing filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return actions with sorting, ordering, and pagination applied, and renders the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the return actions list with sorting, filtering, and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of return actions, applying sorting, pagination, and prepares data for the view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a return action.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new or edited return action, returns JSON response indicating success or errors.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return actions based on POST data and returns JSON response.
